# SQL examples and results

*Generated by `scripts/run_questions.py` from `sql/questions.sql` on the replay run.*

## Complaints per failure mode and year, with share of all complaints

```sql
SELECT primary_fm, f.name,
       SUM(year = '2023') AS y2023, SUM(year = '2024') AS y2024, SUM(year = '2025') AS y2025,
       ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM complaints), 1) AS pct_all
FROM complaints JOIN failure_modes f ON f.code = primary_fm
GROUP BY primary_fm ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC;
```

| primary_fm | name | y2023 | y2024 | y2025 | pct_all |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| FM01 | Catheter body break | 27 | 47 | 52 | 43.8 |
| FM02 | External component failure | 30 | 11 | 7 | 16.7 |
| FM05 | Insertion accessory failure | 14 | 18 | 9 | 14.2 |
| FM08 | Packaging / assembly defect before use | 6 | 3 | 9 | 6.3 |
| FM04 | Kink / deformation | 3 | 3 | 9 | 5.2 |
| FM03 | Occlusion | 4 | 4 | 3 | 3.8 |
| FM12 | Other / insufficient information | 2 | 3 | 4 | 3.1 |
| FM09 | Infection | 3 | 0 | 2 | 1.7 |
| FM13 | Tissue / hypersensitivity reaction | 3 | 1 | 0 | 1.4 |
| FM06 | Malposition / migration | 1 | 3 | 0 | 1.4 |
| FM10 | Thrombosis | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1.0 |
| FM11 | Vessel injury / extravasation | 0 | 1 | 1 | 0.7 |
| FM07 | Difficult insertion / removal | 1 | 1 | 0 | 0.7 |

## Hazards with no row in the reference FMEA, and how serious they were

```sql
SELECT f.code, f.name, COUNT(c.report_number) AS complaints,
       SUM(c.severity IN ('S3','S4','S5')) AS serious, SUM(c.retained_fragment) AS retained_fragments
FROM failure_modes f LEFT JOIN complaints c ON c.primary_fm = f.code
WHERE f.fmea_row IS NULL AND f.code <> 'FM12'
GROUP BY f.code ORDER BY complaints DESC;
```

| code | name | complaints | serious | retained_fragments |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| FM05 | Insertion accessory failure | 41 | 3 | 5 |
| FM04 | Kink / deformation | 15 | 0 | 0 |
| FM06 | Malposition / migration | 4 | 1 | 0 |
| FM07 | Difficult insertion / removal | 2 | 0 | 0 |
| FM11 | Vessel injury / extravasation | 2 | 2 | 0 |

## Where retained fragments come from (failure mode x phase of use)

```sql
SELECT primary_fm, phase, COUNT(*) AS retained_fragments
FROM complaints WHERE retained_fragment = 1
GROUP BY primary_fm, phase ORDER BY retained_fragments DESC;
```

| primary_fm | phase | retained_fragments |
| --- | --- | --- |
| FM01 | P4 | 6 |
| FM05 | P2 | 5 |
| FM01 | P2 | 2 |
| FM01 | P3 | 2 |

## FDA "Fluid/Blood Leak" code vs the coded failure mode

```sql
SELECT primary_fm, COUNT(*) AS complaints,
       ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (), 1) AS pct
FROM complaints WHERE fda_device_problems LIKE '%Leak%'
GROUP BY primary_fm ORDER BY complaints DESC;
```

| primary_fm | complaints | pct |
| --- | --- | --- |
| FM01 | 100 | 80.0 |
| FM02 | 17 | 13.6 |
| FM12 | 3 | 2.4 |
| FM03 | 2 | 1.6 |
| FM11 | 2 | 1.6 |
| FM05 | 1 | 0.8 |

## Manufacturer conclusions: how often a cause was attributed to the device or to use

```sql
SELECT contributor, COUNT(*) AS complaints,
       ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (), 1) AS pct
FROM complaints GROUP BY contributor ORDER BY complaints DESC;
```

| contributor | complaints | pct |
| --- | --- | --- |
| UNK | 240 | 83.3 |
| USE | 26 | 9.0 |
| DEV | 22 | 7.6 |

## Human review workload by reason

```sql
SELECT reason, COUNT(*) AS reports FROM review_queue GROUP BY reason ORDER BY reports DESC;
```
